name: kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed
description: Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed is the faster variant of Kimi K3.1 Pro, delivering comparable intelligence with approximately 2–3× higher output speed and up to a 1M-token context window. It is optimized for long-horizon reasoning and agentic workflows, with strong performance in coding, 3D creation, financial analysis, tool use, and multimodal understanding of text, images, and video.
zhDescription: Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed 是 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的高速版本，在保持相近智能水平的同时，输出速度约提升 2–3 倍，并支持最高 100 万 Token 上下文窗口。模型针对长程推理与智能体工作流进行优化，在编程、3D 创作、金融分析、工具调用，以及文本、图像和视频的多模态理解等场景中表现出色。
